text: publish_gate.title_gate re-cuts the headline AFTER the CMS push: artifact + row title get the adopted title while the CMS and metadata.headline keep the pre-gate one. Fix order: screen the adopted title body-aware, restore its missing content words into the lead (lead_ok), PATCH row title + metadata.headline, then --retitle, then rebuild the front. Related: the internal-link scorer is TITLE-SENSITIVE — re-scoring after a retitle can empty the Related-reading block the first push had stamped; re-stamp or state the gap before --refresh-live
